subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body: 4/5 — polite rep. One thing that might help: the packet scanner said their system matches the held $89 off the case reference that support puts on the reply email — the reference your system shows for the WC-12 onboarding record. So the reply carrying that reference is what does the matching on their side. Appreciate you getting this sorted.
